Built like your in house team, without the headcount.

04 · Process

How we take you from idea to shipped.

Output on every engagement: runbooks, architectural decision records, and a 30 day warranty. No black boxes.

01

Discovery sprint

We embed for five working days. By Friday you have a written spec, a firm quote, and a Loom walkthrough of a working scaffold, before you commit.

02

Scope and price, agreed

We agree a scope and a price together, whether that is a single project or a monthly retainer. If the scope does not change, the price does not.

03

Build in the open

Senior engineers ship in your repo, your CI/CD, your cloud. You watch it happen and own every artifact from day one.

04

Ship and support

Runbooks, ADRs, and a 30 day warranty on every feature. Continue with a monthly retainer only if you want to.
